audience_description: Academic Coordinators in Eduversal partner schools — the operational engine of the school's academic governance. Reports directly to the Principal. Owns: walkthrough scheduling, monitoring data integrity, induction programme oversight, school-wide PD planning, the Central Academic Database, the Lesson Plan Quality Report aggregation, and the Institutional Risk Assessment Report.

framework_anchors.appraisal_framework_v2_1: Coordinator participates in appraisal cycles for AH sub-roles + leads HoD/Subject Leader appraisals where delegated.
framework_anchors.kpi_framework: Owns school-level KPI submission to Eduversal

recurring_tasks.title: Monday Leadership Stand-Up with Principal
recurring_tasks.description: 10-minute standing meeting with Principal to review previous week's database entries, identify Red Flag incidents, set the week's monitoring priorities.
recurring_tasks.first_time_guide: Keep it tight. Three questions: What did last week's data show? What needs eyes this week? Any escalations to flag?

recurring_tasks.title: Monday At-Risk Tracker review
recurring_tasks.description: Review the live At-Risk Tracker. Any student meeting trigger criteria who has not had an action initiated is flagged immediately.

recurring_tasks.title: Run weekly Walkthrough Coverage Report
recurring_tasks.description: Friday EOD: pull the Coverage Report from the Central Academic Database. Any teacher not visited in 14+ days = governance gap. Flag to relevant HoD/Subject Leader for recovery.
evidence_required: Coverage Report attached to weekly file

recurring_tasks.title: Friday Database Integrity Audit
recurring_tasks.description: Verify all walkthrough data from the week is entered (24h rule). Flag any gaps. Flag any incomplete entries. Pre-close ahead of weekend.

recurring_tasks.title: Coordinate Formal Supervision schedule
recurring_tasks.description: Maintain the rolling formal-observation schedule. For teachers in the Teacher Appraisal population, the school's appraisers (Subject Leader / Head of Department, Principal, Academic or Cambridge Coordinator) complete at least three formal F2 observations per teacher per semester, recorded in Edunav Appraisal. Teachers still in Teacher Induction are not on the F2 schedule. Confirm the next 2 weeks of scheduled observations and send the Pre-Observation reminder 1 week ahead.

recurring_tasks.title: Regular pacing check between EASE Weeks
recurring_tasks.description: Between the EASE Weeks, the regular pacing check is the ordinary work of the role. Look for classes more than a chapter behind, subjects where one class is far ahead of another, and teachers whose Common Assessment entries are missing rather than low. Bring a pacing concern to the Head of Department as a question about the pattern, not a judgement about their teaching.
evidence_required: Pacing concerns noted and followed up

recurring_tasks.title: Weekly compliance digest to staff
recurring_tasks.description: Friday afternoon — issue a brief weekly digest to all academic staff: priorities, calendar, recognitions, reminders. Reduces ad hoc messaging.

monthly_tasks.title: Compile and submit Institutional Risk Assessment Report to Principal
monthly_tasks.description: First Monday of month. Aggregate of: Active ASPs, TISC count, ASP exit rate, walkthrough coverage gaps, LPQR trends, language compliance, At-Risk Tracker flow, top 3 PD priorities derived from data.
evidence_required: Reviewed in monthly ALT Dashboard meeting

monthly_tasks.title: Compile Lesson Plan Quality monthly aggregate
monthly_tasks.description: Receive LPQR Monthly Reports from every HoD/Subject Leader (first Monday). Aggregate into school-wide LPQR trend. Identify systemic gaps for PD investment.

monthly_tasks.title: Lead the monthly Learning Walk
monthly_tasks.description: Week 2 of month — coordinate full ALT for a 10-15 classroom Learning Walk with one pre-selected thematic focus. Compile Learning Walk Summary Report within 48 hours.

monthly_tasks.title: Update monthly Domain Heatmap and Language Compliance Heat Map
monthly_tasks.description: Aggregate walkthrough data into school-wide heatmaps. Distribute anonymised version to ALT for monthly Dashboard Review.

monthly_tasks.title: Review monthly PD investment requests against Heatmap evidence
monthly_tasks.description: All PD spending requests this month — does each trace to a Domain Heatmap signal or named IPDL goal? Reject popularity-only requests.

monthly_tasks.title: Audit Joint Walkthrough completion
monthly_tasks.description: Verify each HoD/Subject Leader has completed at least one Joint Walkthrough with Principal this month. Calibration is the discipline that prevents subjectivity drift.

termly_tasks.title: Agree the semester's formal-observation split and build the semester tracking calendar
termly_tasks.description: At the start of each semester, agree with the Principal and the Subject Leaders how the required formal observations are shared, so every teacher is covered and nobody is observed five times by accident. Build your tracking calendar for the whole semester: put the two EASE Weeks of the semester on it, then work backwards from each one.
evidence_required: Semester tracking calendar with EASE Weeks

tasks.title: Distribute Annual Governance Calendar to all HoDs/Subject Leaders
tasks.description: All Week-4 PLC dates, Learning Walk dates, monthly report deadlines, supervision schedule, vertical audit dates. Confirmed in writing.

tasks.title: Lead ALT 6-Domain calibration session
tasks.description: Year-start training: 6 Domains, the 4-level scale, 'I noticed / I wonder' format, the No-Gotcha rule, calibration through Joint Walkthroughs.
evidence_required: Session attended by all ALT members

tasks.title: Open all IPDLs for the year
tasks.description: Verify every academic staff member has an opened IPDL with at least 2 outcome-based goals derived from previous IIP.

tasks.title: Launch baseline walkthrough cycle
tasks.description: Coordinate baseline walkthroughs for every teacher in W2-3. Establishes baseline domain impressions for the year.

tasks.title: Coordinate first Eduversal Specialist visit window
tasks.description: Liaison with Eduversal to schedule Sem-1 school appraisal visits. Coordinate Specialist + Principal joint observation under EPDP.

tasks.title: EASE Week 1 (mid-semester) — EASE Growth; lessons continue
tasks.description: EASE Growth runs in the first two periods on the grade band's assigned day (Wednesday: Grades 7–8 · Thursday: Grades 9–10 · Friday: Grades 11–12). Teacher-Paced Tests also run this week, inside normal periods. Confirm rooms, devices and the grade-band timetable, and check pacing against plan. EASE Week 1 is Semester I school week 12 (28 Sep – 2 Oct 2026). EASE Module: Schedule 26-27 is the operational source for the date — follow it if this checklist week differs.

tasks.title: EASE Week 2 (semester-end) — Synchronized Test; lessons stop
tasks.description: The Synchronized Test is the semester-end part of EASE Assessment (Common Assessment): same subject and same day across every partner school, and the whole week is given to it. Confirm the schedule, invigilation and access; then collect results for analysis. Where the live schedule replaces a Synchronized Test with a Cambridge examination for a grade or subject, the live schedule applies. EASE Week 2 is Semester I school week 22. EASE Module: Schedule 26-27 is the operational source for the date — follow it if this checklist week differs.

tasks.title: Coordinate end-of-Sem-1 grading integrity audit
tasks.description: Support Principal's 10% random work sample re-marking. Coordinate moderation sessions across departments.

tasks.title: Semester I results analysis — Common Assessment and EASE Growth patterns
tasks.description: Read the four gradebook categories separately before you read them together (Grades 7–12: Common Assessment 40%, Class Assignment 30%, Homework Average 20%, Class Participation 10% — EASE Assessment: Gradebook 26-27). Look for patterns by subject and by class; a topic that scores low in more than one class usually points at pacing or the material, not one teacher. EASE Growth is never graded, and in 2026-27 it is a baseline. Bring conclusions, not tables.
evidence_required: Semester I results analysis shared with the Principal

tasks.title: Coordinate mid-year IPDL review cycle across all academic staff
tasks.description: Verify every HoD/Subject Leader runs mid-year IPDL reviews. Aggregate completion data for monthly Risk Report.

tasks.title: Cambridge Oct/Nov results aggregation and analysis
tasks.description: Compile cross-department Cambridge results for Principal review and yayasan reporting.

tasks.title: EASE Week 3 (mid-semester) — EASE Growth; lessons continue
tasks.description: EASE Growth runs in the first two periods on the grade band's assigned day (Wednesday: Grades 7–8 · Thursday: Grades 9–10 · Friday: Grades 11–12); for exam-heavy grades the Semester II sitting may move earlier, before the Cambridge final-examination period. Teacher-Paced Tests also run this week, inside normal periods. Confirm rooms, devices and the grade-band timetable, and check pacing against plan. EASE Week 3 is Semester II school week 13 (Secondary). EASE Module: Schedule 26-27 is the operational source for the date — follow it if this checklist week differs.

27-32.phase: Feb-April — Sem-2 school appraisal visit window

tasks.title: Coordinate Sem-2 Eduversal Specialist visit window
tasks.description: Schedule Sem-2 visits, prepare visit logistics, coordinate Specialist + Principal Leadership Observation under EPDP.

tasks.title: EASE Week 4 (semester-end) — Synchronized Test; lessons stop
tasks.description: Same as EASE Week 2: the whole week is given to the Synchronized Test. Confirm the schedule, invigilation and access; then collect results for analysis. Where the live schedule replaces a Synchronized Test with a Cambridge examination for a grade or subject, the live schedule applies. EASE Week 4 is Semester II school week 19. EASE Module: Schedule 26-27 is the operational source for the date — follow it if this checklist week differs.

tasks.title: Lead Annual Vertical Gap Analysis
tasks.description: Aggregate vertical curriculum maps from each subject. Identify school-wide prerequisite gaps, redundancies, cognitive plateaus. Updated map drives next year's scheme of work.

tasks.title: Annual Resource Suitability Audit
tasks.description: Aggregate resource feedback from departments. Submit Decommission/Renewal List to Principal for budget approval.

tasks.title: Semester II results analysis — Common Assessment and EASE Growth patterns
tasks.description: Same method as Semester I: read the four gradebook categories separately first, look for patterns by subject and by class, and bring conclusions, not tables. Share the analysis with the Principal before it goes to the school's leadership.
evidence_required: Semester II results analysis shared with the Principal

tasks.title: Coordinate annual appraisal cycle for all academic staff
tasks.description: Schedule, evidence packs, IIP filings, dispute resolution support. End-of-year archive.

tasks.title: Annual Governance Archive Audit certification
tasks.description: Verify completeness of Governance Archive: walkthrough records, IIPs, IPDL, ASP/TISC files, Board reports. Sign off and submit to Principal.

extra_tasks_first_12_weeks.title: Work with your cross-school induction guide
extra_tasks_first_12_weeks.description: A newly appointed Academic Coordinator follows Induction Module: Academic Coordinators 26-27 — one academic year with an experienced Academic Coordinator from another partner school, assigned by the Eduversal Academic Board. In your first month your guide walks through the grade-band structures with you, and sits with you before your first EASE Week. The guide supports you and is never your evaluator.

extra_tasks_first_12_weeks.title: Build your semester tracking calendar in your first two weeks
extra_tasks_first_12_weeks.description: Put the four EASE Weeks on it, then work backwards from each one. A Synchronized Test week that arrives as a surprise is a week of lost teaching. Your first year ends at the Readiness Checkpoint (Ready or Extended) — it is a review with your guide and Principal, not a test.
evidence_required: Semester tracking calendar with the four EASE Weeks
